ValidationRule.description: Status = Resolution required Platform, Need, and Outcome to be populated Record Type = Customer Service & Emergency After Hours
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.SSV_PersonaServiceSupervisor = FALSE, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupportEmergencyAfterHours", RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupport", RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_OwnershipTransfer" ), OR( TEXT(Status) = "Solved", TEXT(Status) = "Closed"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(SSV_Platform__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(SSV_Primary__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(SSV_Need__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(SSV_Outcome__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can't update the Status to Resolved until there are values populated for Platform, Primary, Need and Outcome.
